stage1CandidateCoverage.rule: A metric-direction candidate has complete trajectory coverage only when the metric level is defined at all 48 analysis roots (plies 16..63) for all 10 selected Stage 1 trajectories.
stage1CandidateCoverage.reason: This gives the preregistered phrase 'defined level series ... over all primary-eligible windows needed for its observed onsets' a deterministic conservative implementation before fresh evidence.

longitudinalIdentityDefinitions.fullSourceTrajectoryIdentity: SHA-256 of newline-joined canonical move identity keys for the complete deterministic replay through maxSourcePly=80 or earlier terminal state
longitudinalIdentityDefinitions.openingPrefixIdentity: SHA-256 of newline-joined first 16 canonical move identity keys
longitudinalIdentityDefinitions.trajectorySegmentIdentity: SHA-256 of newline-joined records 'ply|rootRawSha256' for analysis plies 16..63
longitudinalIdentityDefinitions.adjacentRootPairIdentity: SHA-256 of 'fromPly|fromRootRawSha256|toPly|toRootRawSha256' for each adjacent analysis-root pair
longitudinalIdentityDefinitions.eventWindowIdentity: SHA-256 of newline-joined 'ply|rootRawSha256' for each four-root window supporting previous/onset/next deltas

upstreamFirewallApplication.rawRoot: reject entire trajectory if any analysis rootRawSha256 occurs in upstream identity-only root set
upstreamFirewallApplication.sourceTrajectory: reject entire trajectory if any analysis-root sourceTrajectorySha256 prefix identity occurs in upstream trajectory set or if full source trajectory identity duplicates another selected trajectory
upstreamFirewallApplication.openingPrefix: reject entire trajectory if first-16 openingPrefixSha256 occurs in upstream identity-only prefix set
upstreamFirewallApplication.withinStageRawRootUniqueness: reject entire candidate trajectory if any of its 48 RAW roots duplicates a RAW root already selected in Stage 1 or repeats within the candidate trajectory

resourceMapping.elapsedMs: per-root wall-clock elapsed time measured by the Stage runner
resourceMapping.peakRssBytes: process max RSS observed at or immediately after each root measurement
resourceMapping.rootArtifactBytes: UTF-8 byte length of canonical root scientific output

unchanged: 48 analysis roots per trajectory at plies 16..63
